name: @kky42/tinyfish-web-mcp

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the live web. Returns up to 10 ranked results (title, URL, snippet; plus date and publisher for news, authors/venue/citations for papers). Use it to find URLs, then read them with web_fetch. In scripts, read structuredContent.results[{title,url,snippet,...}]; check isError first.

recency.description: Only results from the last hour, day, week, month or year. Not supported with domain_type research_paper.

include_domains.description: Limit results to these domains, e.g. ["github.com", "arxiv.org"].

exclude_domains.description: Exclude these domains, e.g. ["pinterest.com"]. Returns no results with domain_type news.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Read web pages as clean markdown, with JavaScript rendered. Up to 10 URLs per call. Each URL returns at most 20000 characters; a truncated page's header gives the offset to continue from. In scripts, read structuredContent.pages[{url,title,text,next_offset}] and .errors; next_offset is null when the page is complete. Markdown conversion can alter structured data (e.g. it escapes _ in JSON keys), so fetch JSON or raw files with a plain HTTP client instead.

offset.description: Character position to start from, applied to every URL. Default 0. To continue a truncated page, use the offset from its header note.

instructions: Search the web with web_search, then read pages with web_fetch (argument `urls` is an array). Results carry structuredContent: web_search {results[{title,url,snippet}]}, web_fetch {pages[{url,text,next_offset}],errors}. Check isError before reading structuredContent.
